subject: Early access revenue guarantee & intro registration process
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara@edgecloud.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Early access revenue guarantee & intro registration process

Hi Aditya & Marissa,

Thanks again for the call today — EdgeCloud is excited about accelerating our integration with Redwood. A few asks from our side to speed the procurement and onboarding timeline:

- We want an early-access revenue guarantee for our first engagements to make implementation economics easier for our sales team.
- Clarity on how lead registration (introduced leads vs co-sell) will be tracked and protected — our salesops needs a 90-day registration window and a clear claim process.
- A short mutual action plan and an MOU we can sign to lock early commercial terms while we complete standard procurement.

Can you share a short-term proposal (term sheet + onboarding checklist) we can review with procurement and legal? If it helps, target timeline for us is pilot deals starting mid-May.

Best,
Sara Li
Head of Partnerships | EdgeCloud Solutions
attachments: none
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara@edgecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early access revenue guarantee & intro registration process

Sara — thanks for the clear asks and the call. Putting a concise proposal on the table so your procurement team has something to review quickly. Summary of what Redwood can offer for an early-access pilot:

- Revenue guarantee: 3-month early-access guarantee equal to a minimum payout of $15,000 to EdgeCloud (applies only to net-new customers introduced by EdgeCloud) OR 12% referral commission on net new ARR for the first 12 months, whichever is higher.
- Implementation credit: one-time 7% implementation commission on the first invoice for deals where EdgeCloud contributes professional services or implementation leads.
- Lead registration: 90-day registration window from first shared qualified lead record. Registration via our Partner Portal (link below) and HubSpot record required for claim.
- Cap: early-access guarantee capped at $60,000 total per partner for initial program unless escalated to Sales Leadership.

Attached: revshare_term_sheet_v1.pdf (term sheet draft), partner_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (onboarding & evidence list).

Next steps I propose:
1) Sara/procurement reviews draft MOU and returns redlines by EOD Fri 5/4.
2) If redlines are minor, we issue a DocuSign MOU and enable partner portal registration.
3) Pilot deal registration (HubSpot link) and kickoff.

Would you like me to loop in Karthik on the revenue-side approval now?

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: revshare_term_sheet_v1.pdf, partner_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clean draft. A few internal alignment notes before we finalize:

- I support increasing the referral % to 12% for early-access partners given the go-to-market investment and the faster ramp expectation.
- Confirming the 90-day registration window is standard — we need to document how we verify 'qualified' status (basic criteria in the checklist).
- Cap is fine but can we add a clause that any guarantee above $60k requires Sales Leadership sign-off and review of customer-level risk.
- For accounting: I attached a quick payout estimate (calculated_payout_estimate.csv) showing expected first-quarter liability at different pilot sizes.

Karthik — can you confirm the affordability profile and whether we should convert the guaranteed minimum into a refundable credit applied against first invoices (helps bookkeeping)? If legal wants the guarantee as a commitment we may need language that frames it as a one-time make-good payment.

Sara — thanks for patience; we'll try to get a cleaner MOU out by Thursday.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Revenue | Redwood Inference

Agree with Marissa. Final decision / approved with the following operational details:

- Final commercial bullets we will publish: 12% referral commission on net-new ARR for months 1–12; 7% implementation commission on first invoice where EdgeCloud led implementation; 3-month minimum payout guarantee floor of $15,000 (payable as a refundable credit against first two invoices or one-time cash make-good; partner preference to be captured in MOU).
- Lead registration: partners must submit a registration entry through our Partner Portal within 7 days of first contact; HubSpot company record + short intake form required. Claims reviewed within 10 business days; disputes escalated to Partner Ops.
- Cap and escalation: guarantee capped at $60k for this pilot cohort; exceptions require director approval and a brief risk memo.
- Next actions: Aditya to update revshare_term_sheet_v2.pdf, Legal to draft MOU language framing guarantee as a limited enrollment incentive. Aditya, please kick off DocuSign once we have partner sign-off.

Approved — Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
